regimes.thresholds: development-period (deribit-eth-perp-2020-04-01) block medians; stress = volatility and spread both above the development 90th percentile

layers.different_regime: regime-conditioned results on every holdout, including regimes rare in development
layers.different_venue: bitstamp-btcusd order-level captures versus Deribit perpetual L2: evaluated only if lob.dataset_registry.comparable accepts the pair; otherwise refused with reasons

analyses.M3: selected model and control E3 and family gates per regime label (blocks pooled within label)
analyses.M4: H4 status per regime label using the frozen M4 thresholds and simulator tables
analyses.M2: frozen M2 aggregate-L2 design on the external holdouts

robustness_rule: a conclusion is regime-robust only if it holds in every regime label with at least 6 valid blocks (30 minutes); labels with fewer blocks are NOT_AVAILABLE
